reworked_diffusion_policy.eval_rlbench
======================================

.. py:module:: reworked_diffusion_policy.eval_rlbench

.. py:data:: _REPO_ROOT

.. py:data:: LOG_POINTCLOUD_INTERVAL
   :value: 20


.. py:function:: _load_config(path: str | None) -> ml_collections.ConfigDict

   Load the training configuration, optionally from a Python module file.

   :param path: Optional path to a Python module defining ``get_config``.

   :returns: Configuration dictionary merged with any overrides from ``path``.


.. py:function:: _build_model(cfg: ml_collections.ConfigDict) -> reworked_diffusion_policy.models.diffusion_policy.DiffusionPolicy

   Construct a :class:`DiffusionPolicy` for evaluation using ``cfg``.

   :param cfg: Configuration dictionary describing the policy architecture.

   :returns: Initialised :class:`DiffusionPolicy` instance.


.. py:function:: _append_camera_frames(obs, buffers: dict) -> None

   Append RGB frames for each camera into ``buffers`` for logging.

   :param obs: RLBench observation providing RGB frames.
   :param buffers: Mapping from camera name to list of frames.


.. py:class:: MaskFilterBuilder(dataset_path: Optional[pathlib.Path], *, ignore_names: Sequence[str], fallback_ids: Sequence[int])

   Constructs per-variation mask filters matching the training dataset.


   .. py:attribute:: _fallback_ids


   .. py:attribute:: _ignore_names


   .. py:attribute:: _variation_mapping
      :type:  Dict[int, Dict[int, str]]


   .. py:attribute:: _name_to_handles
      :type:  Dict[str, set[int]]


   .. py:method:: make_filter(variation: int, task_env, obs) -> Optional[Callable[[numpy.ndarray], numpy.ndarray]]

      Create a boolean mask filter for a given variation, if possible.

      :param variation: RLBench variation identifier.
      :param task_env: RLBench task environment instance.
      :param obs: Latest observation for deriving fallback metadata.

      :returns: Callable converting a mask array into a boolean keep mask, or ``None``.



   .. py:method:: _mapping_from_scene(task_env, obs) -> Dict[int, str]

      Derive a handle→name mapping directly from the RLBench scene.

      :param task_env: RLBench task environment.
      :param obs: Observation containing segmentation masks.

      :returns: Mapping from object handles to resolved names.



.. py:function:: parse_args(argv: Sequence[str]) -> argparse.Namespace

   Parse CLI arguments for the RLBench evaluation script.

   :param argv: Sequence of command-line arguments (excluding script name).

   :returns: Parsed :class:`argparse.Namespace`.


.. py:function:: main(argv: Sequence[str]) -> None

   Evaluate a trained diffusion policy on RLBench tasks.

   :param argv: Command-line arguments provided by :mod:`argparse` or ``sys.argv``.
